record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.context_brief: Uniform and mean convergence of compact-support Fourier-Sobolev sums
record.original_question: For Fourier-Sobolev series built from the orthogonal polynomials associated with a discrete Sobolev-type inner product using Jacobi or generalized Jacobi weights and interior mass points, determine natural uniform-convergence and mean-convergence results for the partial sums, in the spirit of known weighted norm inequalities for polynomial expansions associated with measures with mass points.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\alpha,\beta>-1$ and consider the Jacobi weight $w^{(\alpha,\beta)}(x)=(1-x)^\alpha(1+x)^\beta$ on $(-1,1)$ (or, more generally, a generalized Jacobi weight of the form $w(x)=w^{(\alpha,\beta)}(x)\prod_{j} |x-t_j|^{\gamma_j}h(x)$, with $h$ positive and continuous on $[-1,1]$ and $t_j\in(-1,1)$). Fix points $c_1,\dots,c_N\in(-1,1)$, nonnegative real numbers $M_{i,k}$, and a nonnegative integer $r$. Define the discrete Sobolev-type inner product
$$\langle f,g\rangle_S \;=\; \int_{-1}^{1} f(x)g(x)\,w(x)\,dx \;+\; \sum_{i=1}^{N}\sum_{k=0}^{r} M_{i,k}\, f^{(k)}(c_i)\, g^{(k)}(c_i).$$
Let $\{Q_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ be the sequence of monic polynomials orthogonal with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$, and for $f$ in a suitable class define the Fourier-Sobolev partial sums
$$S_n(f,x)=\sum_{k=0}^{n}\frac{\langle f,Q_k\rangle_S}{\langle Q_k,Q_k\rangle_S}\,Q_k(x).$$

Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $\alpha,\beta$, on the parameters $M_{i,k}$ and $c_i$, on a weight function $u$ on $(-1,1)$, and on an exponent $p\in[1,\infty)$ (resp.\ on a function space such as $C[-1,1]$), under which one has:
(a) (Mean convergence) $\|S_n(f)-f\|_{L^p(u\,dx)}\to 0$ as $n\to\infty$ for every $f$ in the corresponding weighted $L^p$ space;
(b) (Uniform convergence) $\|S_n(f)-f\|_{L^\infty[-1,1]}\to 0$ for every $f$ in a natural class of continuous functions on $[-1,1]$.

Establish analogues, in this Jacobi-Sobolev setting, of the classical weighted norm inequalities for partial sums of Fourier expansions in orthogonal polynomials with respect to measures having interior mass points.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem on uniform and mean convergence of Fourier-Sobolev partial sums for Jacobi/generalized Jacobi weights with interior mass points. Subsequent work (e.g., by Marcellán, Quintana, and collaborators) has produced partial results for specific Sobolev inner products and special mass-point configurations, but a complete characterization in the generality stated has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in Jacobi-Sobolev Fourier series
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems concerning uniform and mean convergence of Fourier-Sobolev sums for Jacobi-type weights with mass points.
status_evidence.claim: The convergence questions are listed as open problems.
